headline: Eastern Front Reopens As Intense Clashes Shake Callahan's Passage
war_summary: Violent combat has flared anew along the eastern perimeter, where Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse broke their brief pause to record eleven combined strategic base transfers in the past two hours under crushing artillery and infantry clashes that claimed over thirty-six hundred men. Callahan's Passage has similarly destabilized, logging its first fresh territorial upheavals of the night around The Latch as casualty rates accelerated sharply on both sides. In the maritime theaters, Godcrofts completed an aggressive consolidation under Colonial control following nine rapid exchanges, whereas Fishermans Row sustains bitter amphibious fighting across Arcadia and Eidolo with fifteen hundred casualties and three base shifts in the last two hours. Linn of Mercy remains an unrelenting meat grinder, yielding two more base conversions and leaving one stronghold in ruins amidst nearly nineteen hundred fallen troops. Conversely, the raging territorial swings in Stonecradle have momentarily halted with zero base captures over the last two hours, though accelerating casualties signal that the frontline remains severely pressed.
